KITSUNE_FIRE_STRIKE.title: Foxfire Strike
LIGHT_CARD.title: Miss Zhao is Our Light!
SECTION_INTRO.title: Section - Intro
SECTION_INTRO.description:
Unplayable in Diva Form.
Enter [gold]Diva Form[/gold].
Gain [gold]Section[/gold] - Intro.
Draw 1 card.
This card transforms into [gold]Main[/gold].
EMERGENCY_TREATMENT.title: Emergency Treatment
EMERGENCY_TREATMENT.description:
Unplayable in Nurse Form.
Enter [gold]Nurse Form[/gold].
Gain 1 [gold]Healing[/gold].
Heal 5 HP.
SECTION_MAIN.title: Section - Main
SECTION_MAIN.description:
Intro: spend 1 Foxfire, Chase 1 time (6 damage), heal 6 HP, gain 1 Energy.
Miko: spend 1 Foxfire, Chase 6 damage, gain 3 Strength.
Lady: spend 2 Light, gain 1 Foxfire, gain 1 Energy.
Nurse: whenever you play a Skill, gain 1 Healing.
This card transforms into [gold]Chorus[/gold].
SECTION_CHORUS.title: Section - Chorus
SECTION_CHORUS.description:
Enter [gold]Chorus[/gold].
Gain [gold]Liberation[/gold].
Removed from this combat.
OUTRO_CARD.title: Outro
OUTRO_CARD.description:
Can only be played during the Interlude.
Advance the Interlude to the [gold]Outro[/gold].
LIGHT_YO.title: O Light!
LIGHT_YO.description:
Can only be played in Lady Form.
Spend all [gold]Light[/gold]; deal (Light spent x 2) damage.
CHASE_CHASE.title: Chase Chase
CHASE_CHASE.description:
[gold]Foxfire[/gold]{Foxfire}.
Chase [blue]{Hits}[/blue] times, [blue]{ChaseDamage}[/blue] damage each.
Miko Form: additional Chases.
FAST_FORWARD.title: Fast Forward
FAST_FORWARD.description:
Gain 2 Vulnerable and 2 Weak.
If you have a Section: advance it to the next stage.
If you don't: gain a [gold]Section[/gold].
